## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复 Codex 本地 API 实例关闭「注入网络代理」后，上游请求仍使用账号或默认网络代理的问题。实例关闭代理时，客户端和该实例的管理器 API 转发均使用明确的直连设置。
- 启动确认页的单次代理选择会传递到实例专属网关。不开启的代理不再触发资源校验或隧道准备，账号、其他实例和独立本地 API 服务的代理设置保持不变。
- 更新创建、编辑及启动确认中的说明，明确开关对整个实例请求路径的作用。保存的默认值与本次启动覆盖继续分别生效。
- 本次修复在新版启动实例时生效，不会热改已经运行的旧网关，不需要调整供应商密钥或放宽 TLS 验证。

- Fixes Codex local API instances continuing to use the account or default network proxy after proxy injection was disabled. An opted-out instance now uses explicit direct routing for both its client and its dedicated manager API forwarding.
- Carries the per-launch choice into the instance gateway and skips unused proxy validation and tunnel preparation. Shared account settings, other instances and standalone local API services keep their configured routes.
- Clarifies the creation, editing and launch confirmation descriptions. Saved preferences and single-launch overrides remain independent.
- The fix applies when an instance starts with the new version. Existing gateway processes are not modified live; provider keys and TLS certificate verification do not need to change.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP 和 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。账号、实例、会话及本地配置保留。运行实例结束且管理器完全退出后再切换新版；普通退出可能保留后台服务。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证；Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Accounts, instances, sessions and settings are retained. Switch versions after active instances finish and the manager exits completely; ordinary Quit may retain background services. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

支持 Codex 桌面 / CLI、macOS Claude Desktop 独立实例的客户端内登录或 API / 第三方连接，以及 macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI 的 API Key、Bearer 和订阅 OAuth 连接；客户端需单独安装。本次修复针对 Codex 的实例专属本地 API 网关，Claude 原有代理处理不变。

Supports Codex desktop / CLI, independent macOS Claude Desktop instances with in-client sign-in or API / third-party connections, and the official native macOS Claude Code CLI with API Key, Bearer or subscription OAuth connections. Install clients separately. This fix targets the dedicated local API gateway of Codex instances; existing Claude proxy handling is unchanged.

## 验证来源 / Verification

定向回归覆盖共享账号的并行实例、保存与单次代理开关、无效代理资源、API 请求实际直连 / 代理路径，以及 OAuth / Agent Identity 的网络配置投影。网络行为测试使用源码构建的转发程序与本机模拟服务；界面测试使用真实管理器与隔离数据。完整验证包括 TypeScript、Go、管理器界面和 macOS arm64 打包验收，不使用真实账号或付费模型，不声明重新验证上游登录、模型能力或系统级透明代理行为。

Focused regression covers concurrent instances sharing an account, saved and per-launch proxy choices, invalid proxy resources, actual direct/proxied API traffic, and OAuth / Agent Identity network projections. Network tests use the source-built relay with loopback fixtures; UI checks use the actual manager with isolated data. Full verification includes TypeScript, Go, manager UI and macOS arm64 packaged-app acceptance. No real accounts or paid models are used, and upstream sign-in, model capabilities and system-level transparent proxy behavior are not claimed as newly validated.
